answer: Reaching the canyon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Each submission hangs on the reef of a task receipt, and the sonnet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
